# SpriteAnimator

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("SpriteAnimator")`

Plays the frames of a sprite sheet on its parent `Part2D`, on simulation time, so a walk cycle needs no script. On each tick that it plays, it sets the parent's `ImageRectOffset` and `ImageRectSize` to the current frame.

Frames are counted along the rows of the sheet, starting at `SheetOffset`, with `Columns` frames per row. An animation that is not looped stops at its end and sets `Playing` to false. To be notified, connect to `GetPropertyChangedSignal("Playing")`.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Columns` | `number` | `1` | read/write | The number of frames in one row of the sheet. |
| `FirstFrame` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The frame the animation starts on, counted from `SheetOffset`. |
| `Frame` | `number` | — | read-only | The current frame, counted from 0 at `FirstFrame`. |
| `FrameCount` | `number` | `1` | read/write | The number of frames the animation plays. |
| `FrameSize` | `Vector2` | `Vector2.new(16, 16)` | read/write | The size of one frame in the sheet, in pixels. |
| `FramesPerSecond` | `number` | `8` | read/write | The speed of the animation, in frames per second of simulation time. |
| `Looped` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the animation starts again at its end. When it is off, the animation stops on its last frame. |
| `Playing` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether the animation is advancing. Setting it to true starts from `FirstFrame` if the animation had stopped at its end, and continues from the current frame if it was paused. |
| `SheetOffset` | `Vector2` | — | read/write | The position of frame 0, in pixels from the top left of the sheet. Use it to keep several animations in one sheet, one below another. |
